events.title: Wallet on the sidewalk
events.text: A fat wallet on the sidewalk. $240 in cash, an ID, family photos.

effects.tpl: Owner cries, gives $20 reward. Karma soars.
New games! And a weird hollow feeling.

events.title: Chess club invite
events.text: The chess captain saw you thinking three moves ahead at lunch.

effects.tpl: Openings, endgames, trophies. Brain gains.
You pass. The captain never forgets.

events.title: The game everyone plays
events.text: Everyone's obsessed with a new game. You beg for it for your birthday.

effects.tpl: Diamond rank! Grades wobble slightly.
Weekend fun, homework still done. Balance!
You read three novels while friends grind. Teachers notice.

events.title: First crush
events.text: A crush that makes hallways feel electric keeps smiling at you.

then.tpl: They said YES! Hand-holding era begins.

else.tpl: A kind 'let's be friends'. It stings for weeks.

effects.tpl: You write poems you'll burn at 25.

events.title: Finals week
events.text: Four exams, one week, zero mercy.

effects.tpl: A's across the board. You forget sunlight.
Solid B's and a functioning brain.

then.tpl: You wing it into a B+. Teachers are baffled.

else.tpl: Disaster. Red ink everywhere.

events.title: The big party
events.text: Invite to THE party. Rumor: no parents, older kids, 'bring something'.

then.tpl: Legendary night. Grounded for a month Monday.

else.tpl: Wild night, great stories, no consequences (this time).

effects.tpl: You have fun AND remember it. People respect that.
FOMO stings until Monday's drama stories.

events.title: Gym era
events.text: Everyone's getting fit. The gym offers a teen deal.

effects.tpl: Six months of iron. Transformation arc complete.
Push-ups in the bedroom. Slow but real gains.

events.title: First job offer
events.text: The corner store will hire you weekends: $150/week.

effects.tpl: A year of weekends = $1,800 saved. Grades dip slightly.
Grades climb. Wallet stays thin.

events.title: Peer pressure
events.text: Cool kids offer you a vape behind the gym. 'Everyone does it.'

effects.tpl: You walk away. Real friends respect it later.
Coughing fit. They laugh. You never touch it again.

events.title: Viral video
events.text: Your silly video hits 2M views overnight. Brands DM you.

effects.tpl: Brand deals pay ${{w}}! Followers flood in. Fame is weird.
You delete it. Peace > fame.

events.title: Answers for sale
events.text: A kid sells the math final answers for $30.

then.tpl: A-! Your conscience itches all summer.

else.tpl: CAUGHT. Zero + detention. Expensive lesson.

effects.tpl: You study and earn a B+. Sleep well.

events.title: Garage band
events.text: Friends need a bassist. They own a garage and zero skills.

effects.tpl: Noise becomes music. First gig: a birthday. Magic.
They become locally famous without you. Ouch.

events.title: Student walkout
events.text: Students plan a walkout for a cause you half-understand.

effects.tpl: You march, chant, learn. It feels like history.
Quiet classroom, loud conscience.

events.title: Squealing tires
events.text: A friend with a new license offers a 'fun ride' — clearly too fast.

then.tpl: Terrifying, thrilling, survived.

else.tpl: CRASH. Hospital, cast, $2,000 bill. You survived.

effects.tpl: You walk home. They wrap the car around a pole (everyone lives).

events.title: Summer romance
events.text: A summer-camp / beach romance: intense, doomed by August.

effects.tpl: The best six weeks of your teens. The goodbye hurts beautifully.
Fun fling, easy parting, good stories.

events.title: Hackathon weekend
events.text: 48-hour hackathon. Free pizza, no sleep, big prizes.

then.tpl: Your app wins 2nd place! $1,500!

else.tpl: No prize, but you learn more in 48h than a semester.

effects.tpl: You sleep 10 hours while friends hallucinate code.

events.title: Missing posters
events.text: Your pet slipped the leash and vanished. Rain is coming.

then.tpl: Found at 3am under a porch! The reunion hug heals everything.

else.tpl: You search anyway and rescue a lost kitten instead.

then.tpl: They trot home at dawn, muddy and proud.

else.tpl: Gone three days. You never fully forgive yourself.

events.title: Road trip!
events.text: Friends plan a cheap road trip: bad motels, great playlists. $400 each.

effects.tpl: Sunburns, diners, wrong turns. Core memory unlocked.
You stay home. The photos hurt.

events.title: Tutoring gig
events.text: A neighbor pays $25/hr for math tutoring.

effects.tpl: A year of Tuesdays = $1,200 and sharper brains.
Free Tuesdays. Empty wallet.

events.title: A scout is watching
events.text: A talent scout saw you perform and wants a meeting.

then.tpl: Signed! First advance: $25,000!

else.tpl: Meetings, maybes, silence. The industry is brutal.

effects.tpl: You keep joy unsponsored.

events.title: Lights in the sky
events.text: 3am. Humming. A beam. Classic abduction setup.

then.tpl: They probe your mind, upgrade it, return you by breakfast. Smarts +15!
Zoo trip: they show you Andromeda and drop you home.

else.tpl: Weird dreams and a missing Tuesday. Health -.

effects.tpl: Personal best sprint. The light fades.

events.title: Message from the future
events.text: An email from YOURSELF, dated 20 years ahead: 'Buy land. Be kind. Call mom.'

effects.tpl: You call mom. She cries happy. The land tip… wait and see.
Probably phishing. Probably.

events.title: Scratch ticket
events.text: A friend gifts a $2 scratch ticket for fun.

then.tpl: $500 winner!! You scream in the store!
$10 back. Breakfast is free.

else.tpl: Dust. Still fun.

effects.tpl: You pass the luck along.

events.title: Dark alley
events.text: A figure steps out: 'Wallet. Now.'

effects.tpl: You lose ${{l}}. Shaken, alive. That's what matters.

then.tpl: Training pays! They flee. You shake for an hour.

else.tpl: Beaten and robbed (${{l}}). Hospital visit.

then.tpl: Gone like wind. Adrenaline for days.

else.tpl: Caught, shoved, robbed $300.

events.title: Storm of the decade
events.text: Sirens wail. The sky turns green. A monster storm is coming.

effects.tpl: Batteries, water, blankets. The roof holds. $200 supplies.

then.tpl: Incredible photos! 50k likes!

else.tpl: Debris strike. Hospital + $5,000 damage.

events.title: Cold hands
events.text: A shivering person asks for change outside the store.

effects.tpl: Their smile warms you for days.
You avoid eye contact. It itches.

events.title: Lost & found karma
events.text: You lose your wallet with $200. Hours later a teen messages: 'Found it?'

then.tpl: Everything intact! You give $20 reward. Faith in humanity +.

else.tpl: Wallet gone, lesson kept. Ouch.

events.title: Reality TV casting
events.text: Casting agents want YOU for a reality show: 6 weeks, $10k, possible fame.

then.tpl: Fan favorite! $10k + 200k followers!

else.tpl: Edited as the villain. $10k consolation.

effects.tpl: Dignity intact.

events.title: Feast invitation!
events.text: A wealthy cousin invites House {{s.lastName}} to a grand feast: roast, wine, gossip.

effects.tpl: You toast, dance, network. +10 prestige!
Your gift steals the night. Bards mention House {{s.lastName}}. +22 prestige!
You stay home. The pies were apparently legendary.

events.title: Boar hunt!
events.text: Friends (or vassals, you joke) plan a weekend boar hunt. Mud, dogs, glory.

then.tpl: A clean chase! The boar feeds the village. +14 prestige!

else.tpl: The boar disagrees. Muddy, bruised, humbled.

effects.tpl: You guard the pies. Someone must.

events.title: Scholarship letter!
events.text: A university offers a FULL scholarship — if grades hold at 90+. Yours: {{s.education.grades}}.

then.tpl: SIGNED. Tuition: $0. The library becomes home.

else.tpl: Just short — but the chase lifts your grades.

effects.tpl: Straight to work. The school of life charges different fees.

events.title: Open auditions!
events.text: A casting call for a streaming series — thousands will show. Your traits: {{s.traits||[].join(", ")||"none"}}.

then.tpl: CAST! Recurring role, $12,000! Fans learn your name!

else.tpl: Callbacks, maybes, silence. The industry is brutal.

effects.tpl: You run cables, learn everything, get paid.

events.title: Dance challenge!
events.text: A 15-second dance is eating the internet. Your friends dare you to post.

then.tpl: 10M VIEWS! Brand deals flood in. +fame!

else.tpl: 400 views. 380 are family. Still fun.

effects.tpl: You keep your dignity and your anonymity.

events.title: Hate follows fame
events.text: Success brings stalkers, think-pieces, and 4,000 quote-tweets about your haircut.

effects.tpl: Assistants, boundaries, beach. Peace restored.
Never read the comments. You read the comments.

events.title: A bad flu season
events.text: A nasty flu sweeps the city. Schools debate closures. Grandma coughs ominously.

effects.tpl: Soup, thermometers, love. Everyone pulls through.
Boring. Healthy. Correct.

events.title: Spring dance
events.text: The spring dance. Lights, a bad DJ, and a crush across the gym from {{s.firstName}}.

then.tpl: YES! Three slow songs. Floating home.

else.tpl: A kind no. The fries help.

effects.tpl: Your crew owns the dance floor. No slow songs, no problem.

events.title: Picture-day volcano
events.text: Picture day. A volcano erupts on {{s.firstName}}'s forehead overnight.

effects.tpl: It fights back. Concealer, damage control, survival.
Prescription magic. Clear in weeks.
You walk in chin-up. Confidence is the best filter.

events.title: Cafeteria war
events.text: A single airborne meatball arcs over {{s.firstName}}'s tray. The cafeteria holds its breath.

then.tpl: Mashed-potato hero! Legends are born.

else.tpl: Detention and cleanup duty. Worth it? Yes.

effects.tpl: You eat in peace amid flying gravy. Monk mode.

events.title: Curfew: 10pm
events.text: The party ends at midnight. Curfew is ten. {{s.firstName}} does the math out loud.

then.tpl: Best night ever. Silent window re-entry.

else.tpl: Busted at 12:03. Grounded weekends.

then.tpl: A calm pitch works. Trust plus one.

else.tpl: No budging. Ten it is. Democracy fails.

events.title: Sibling leverage
events.text: Your sibling read {{s.firstName}}'s messages and wants $20 for silence.

effects.tpl: Peace purchased. They will be back. They always come back.

then.tpl: Mutually assured silence. Cold war.

else.tpl: Escalation! Both grounded. Nobody wins.

effects.tpl: You tell everything first. Their leverage evaporates.

events.title: Debate coach notices
events.text: The debate coach watched {{s.firstName}} argue about cafeteria portions and smelled potential.

then.tpl: Trophies and terrifying rebuttals. College apps glow.

else.tpl: First tournament: crushed. Second: less crushed.

effects.tpl: You keep opinions recreational.

events.title: $1,000 essay
events.text: Scholarship essay for {{s.firstName}}: What home means to me. Deadline Sunday.

then.tpl: Your essay makes a judge cry. $1,000!

else.tpl: No win, but the writing muscles grow.

then.tpl: Nobody checks. The money spends fine; sleep does not.

else.tpl: Plagiarism hearing. Zero, shame, lesson.

events.title: First paycheck: $180
events.text: {{s.firstName}} holds a first real paycheck: $180. It burns a hole straight through the pocket.

effects.tpl: Bank account: $180. Smugness: priceless.
Sneakers, snacks, arcade. Gone by Friday. Zero regrets (some regrets).
$90 saved, $90 savored. The ancient art of balance.

events.title: Senior sells fakes
events.text: A senior sells fakes for $60. The concert is 18+. {{s.firstName}} does the math.

effects.tpl: You hear the show from the parking lot. Still pretty good.

then.tpl: Scanned, stamped, inside! Best night ever.

else.tpl: Busted at the door. Parents called. Grounded era.

events.title: License test day
events.text: License test day for {{s.firstName}}. Parallel parking — humanity's cruelest invention.

effects.tpl: LICENSED! The open road smells like freedom.

then.tpl: One try, nailed it. Natural.

else.tpl: Curb: 1, You: 0. Retest $35.

events.title: The fence has work
events.text: A fence named {{s.underworld&&s.underworld.crew.length?s.underworld.crew[0].name:"Sal"}} offers {{s.firstName}} a quiet job: drive, wait, ask nothing.

effects.tpl: Easy miles, fat envelope: +${{pay}}. Heat ticks up.
You pass. The fence nods — there's always next time.

events.title: Canteen debt
events.text: {{s.firstName}} owes Big Marv from the poker table. Marv collects on Fridays and smiles the rest of the week.

then.tpl: Can't pay. Friday hurts.

else.tpl: Paid. Marv almost looks disappointed.

effects.tpl: Laundry mountains, kitchen grease. Debt cleared in sweat.

then.tpl: You stare Marv down. The yard decides you're crazy. Respect +.

else.tpl: Friday arrives with fists. You eat through a straw for a week.

events.title: The cellmate's plan
events.text: The new cellmate has been inside nine years and has a plan involving the laundry rota, a laundry cart, and Tuesday.

effects.tpl: Nine years of knowledge in nine nights. The joint holds no more surprises.
A year shaved. The yard will remember the price.

events.title: Shakedown week
events.text: New warden, new rules: surprise searches, dogs, confiscated everything down to shoelaces.

effects.tpl: Bunk, books, burpees. The storm passes over you.

then.tpl: Cigarettes, phone time, chocolate. +$900. The block owes you.

else.tpl: Caught at the fence line. +2 years. The dogs remember you.

events.title: AP gauntlet
events.text: Three AP exams in one week. The curve is a rumor.

effects.tpl: Fours and a five. The transcript shines.
Steady scores, intact brain. Balance wins.

events.title: Portfolio push
events.text: Art school needs twelve pieces by January.

effects.tpl: Twelve pieces, three great. Accepted with scholarship buzz.
Legal walls only. Your style gets recognized downtown.

events.title: Babysitting ring
events.text: Three families want Friday nights. You could subcontract.

effects.tpl: You coordinate sitters and take a cut. You net 350 dollars.
One loyal family, premium pay, zero chaos.

events.title: Band trip
events.text: Three days, two shows, one bus with no air conditioning.

effects.tpl: Your solo earns a standing ovation in another town.
You keep the bus laughing. The trip runs on you.

events.title: Final cut
events.text: Twelve spots, fifteen players. The list posts Friday.

then.tpl: Number twelve: you. The jersey smells like destiny.

else.tpl: Cut. You join rec league and drop 20 a game.

effects.tpl: Stat keeper, hype crew, film study. Essential anyway.

events.title: Wrench skills
events.text: The bike co-op teaches repairs. Flats fixed free for kids.

effects.tpl: You fix half the block. Tips total 120 dollars.
Free repairs for kids. The co-op pins a star on you.

events.title: Century ride
events.text: The cycling club plans 100 miles. Your longest is 30.

then.tpl: You finish all 100. The medal weighs a pound.

else.tpl: Sixty miles, then the sag wagon. Respect earned anyway.

effects.tpl: Water, snacks, cheers. Finishers hug you first.

events.title: First donation
events.text: The blood drive bus parks outside. You weigh enough.

effects.tpl: One pint, three lives. Cookies taste heroic after.
You bring six friends. The bus sets a school record.

events.title: Storm night
events.text: The camping trip meets a real thunderstorm at 2am.

effects.tpl: Guy-lines tightened in lightning. Tent holds. Legend made.
Everyone crams in the car, laughing. The storm becomes lore.

events.title: Blitz night
events.text: Twenty boards, five minutes each, one long night.

effects.tpl: Eleven wins. The last game ends past midnight.
The night runs clean. You are the reason.

events.title: Summer retreat
events.text: A weekend retreat: canoes, songs, no phones.

effects.tpl: Three days offline. The stars file a comeback.
Your campfire set gets requested nightly.

events.title: Hack night
events.text: The coding club ships a game in one weekend.

effects.tpl: Your physics code works first try. The game slaps.
Pixel sprites with actual charm. Players screenshot them.

events.title: The note
events.text: A folded note lands on your desk: CHECK YES OR NO.

then.tpl: YES wins. Hallway hand-holding begins Monday.

else.tpl: The no stings. Your friends stage a three-day comfort operation.

effects.tpl: You stay mysterious. The note becomes legend.

events.title: Curfew summit
events.text: Midnight curfew feels medieval. Your parents agree to negotiate.

effects.tpl: 1am on weekends, earned monthly. Diplomacy works.
Home by midnight, rested and trusted. Freedom grows.

events.title: Debate finals
events.text: Regionals. Your case is strong; your opponent is famous.

effects.tpl: You win on points. The trophy is ugly and beloved.
You lose the round but win the room. Coach nods anyway.

events.title: Rival school match
events.text: The cross-town rivals talk trash. The motion: school uniforms.

effects.tpl: Your rebuttal silences their captain. Trophy stays home.
Pizza with the enemy. Next year: rematch and friends.

events.title: Diner nights
events.text: The all-night diner hires weekend help. Coffee flows like a river.

effects.tpl: Midnight crowds, big tips. You bank 290 dollars.
You learn forty orders by heart. The diner loves you.

events.title: Basement show
events.text: A friend's band needs an opener. You know three songs.

effects.tpl: Thirty kids in a basement. You play like it is thousands.
You run the door fairly and the sound loudly. Show: saved.

events.title: Permit day
events.text: Learner's permit in hand. The parking lot awaits.

effects.tpl: Parallel parking: nailed. The examiner almost smiles.
Merging terror survived. Dad's brake foot finally relaxes.

events.title: Varsity esports
events.text: The school forms an esports team. Tryouts Friday.

effects.tpl: You make starting five. The trophy case gains LEDs.
Your calls win the JV league. Shot-caller reputation.

events.title: Finals week
events.text: Four finals, three days, one backpack full of highlighters.

then.tpl: You ace three of four. The GPA breathes again.

else.tpl: Two Bs, two Cs. Survival counts as victory.

effects.tpl: Eight hours nightly. Your brain thanks you with Bs.

events.title: Bonfire farewell
events.text: A best friend moves away. One last bonfire.

effects.tpl: Stories till 2am. The coals keep the promises.
Forty pages of us. They cry at the airport.

events.title: Market stall
events.text: Your jam and honey stall gets a Saturday slot.

effects.tpl: Gone by noon. You net 210 dollars and a waiting list.
Tastes convert. Regulars form by week three.

events.title: Dance invitation
events.text: The fall dance approaches and courage is on sale.

then.tpl: Yes! The gym glows and your shoes survive.

else.tpl: A gentle no. The punch is still good.

effects.tpl: Matching shirts, zero drama, all the slow songs air-conducted.

events.title: The breakup
events.text: It ends over text. Three dots, then nothing.

effects.tpl: Ice cream, sad songs, friends on the floor. You mend.
New haircut, new records. The hallway notices.

events.title: Scoop shop hire
events.text: The ice cream shop hires at 15. The hat is ridiculous.

effects.tpl: One summer of scoops. You save 320 dollars and gain wrists of steel.
Next summer, the chair is yours. Patience pays.

events.title: Rumor mill
events.text: The school says you kissed someone. You did not. Yet.

effects.tpl: You deny with style. The rumor dies of boredom.

then.tpl: Plot twist: you ask them out for real. It works.

else.tpl: Bold ask, kind no. The rumor retires anyway.

events.title: Paycheck one
events.text: First real paycheck. The number has a comma's little cousin.

effects.tpl: Half to savings. Future-you sends thanks.
Dinner out with the crew. Earned and enjoyed.

events.title: School election
events.text: Class president. Your speech is Tuesday. The posters are up.

then.tpl: Victory by 30 votes! The gavel is heavier than expected.

else.tpl: You lose to a dance campaign. Democracy stings.

effects.tpl: Your candidate wins. The real power: you.

events.title: Teen derby
events.text: The lake derby pays 100 dollars for the biggest bass.

then.tpl: Four-pounder at 6am! You weigh in first and win.

else.tpl: Skunked. The sunrise was still worth the alarm.

effects.tpl: You teach casting all morning. Three kids catch first fish.

events.title: Truck rally
events.text: Twelve trucks, one afternoon, empty stomachs.

effects.tpl: Twelve trucks, twelve bites. The dumpling wins.
Scorecards, debates, a champion crowned. Tradition born.

events.title: Garage band era
events.text: Three chords, a borrowed amp, and a drummer who owns one stick.

effects.tpl: First gig: a birthday party. You play loud and they dance.
Homework Blues becomes the school anthem.

events.title: Garage gold
events.text: Cleaning the garage reveals boxes from 1998.

effects.tpl: Old games and gear sell fast. You split 130 dollars with the house.
A box of your baby clothes. Mom cries. You keep it all.

events.title: Tape the stories
events.text: Grandpa's stories are fading. Your phone records beautifully.

effects.tpl: Ten hours saved. The family archive begins with you.
The river story, written down. Grandpa frames it.

events.title: Iron beginnings
events.text: The school weight room opens to freshmen. The bar is empty and honest.

effects.tpl: Squat, press, pull. Numbers climb monthly. Strength becomes identity.
400 meters of fire. The team jacket fits perfectly.

events.title: Trail crew
events.text: The hiking club attempts the ridge loop: 12 miles, big views.

effects.tpl: Summit at noon. The valley spreads out like a promise.
You walk last, nobody left behind. The slow ones thank you.

events.title: History fair
events.text: Your project: the town's forgotten mill fire of 1911.

effects.tpl: Newspaper scans, interviews, a standing ovation. Ribbon: first.
A ten-minute play. The mill burns nightly to applause.

events.title: Float build
events.text: The homecoming float needs builders, painters, and a driver.

effects.tpl: The dragon float wins first. You ride the throne.
Scales, eyes, fire. Your art rolls down Main Street.

events.title: Chase the truck
events.text: The truck takes a new route. The chase is on.

effects.tpl: Caught at the third corner. Victory tastes like bomb pop.
You map the Wednesdays. Never miss again.

events.title: Exchange student
events.text: An exchange student arrives with two suitcases and zero English slang.

effects.tpl: By December they roast perfectly. Your work here is done.
You gain a language, a family abroad, and a graduation invite.

events.title: Shelf crew
events.text: The library needs shelvers. The quiet is a perk.

effects.tpl: You shelve at supernatural speed. Librarians nod.
Toddlers adore you. Reading spreads like joy.

events.title: Math olympiad
events.text: The invitational: five problems, three hours, silence.

then.tpl: Honorable mention. The certificate goes on the fridge.

else.tpl: Two solved fully. The third haunts you pleasantly.

effects.tpl: Your team places. Collaboration points: max.

events.title: Mini golf league
events.text: Summer mini golf league. The windmill hole decides all.

effects.tpl: Hole-in-one on fourteen. The league gasps.
Trick shots only. You finish last and first in hearts.

events.title: Legal wall
events.text: The city opens a legal mural wall. Your crew gets a panel.

effects.tpl: A phoenix over the river. Strangers photograph it daily.
Time-lapse of the whole piece. The city shares it.

events.title: Mow money
events.text: Five lawns, every Saturday, cash on the porch.

effects.tpl: Stripes so straight they photograph. 300 dollars earned.
Three perfect lawns, referrals booked. Business grows.

events.title: Orchard season
events.text: Apple season pays by the bushel. Ladders provided.

effects.tpl: Forty bushels. Arms ache, wallet glows: 380 dollars.
Press duty with the crew. Sticky, loud, wonderful.

events.title: Espresso apprentice
events.text: The cafe trains you on the machine. Milk physics awaits.

effects.tpl: Rosettas for days. Regulars request you. 280 dollars banked.
5am shifts build character and 320 dollars.

events.title: Bookstore shifts
events.text: The used bookstore hires a teen for weekends.

effects.tpl: You read 40 books by osmosis and bank 230 dollars.
Your shelf-talkers triple sales. Customers ask for you.

events.title: Grocery grind
events.text: Bagging groceries after school. The rush hour is war.

effects.tpl: Fastest bagger on shift. You bank 260 dollars.
Mrs. Alvarez tips in cookies. The job glows.

events.title: Decisions season
events.text: Everyone discusses colleges. Your list is blank.

effects.tpl: Big, small, weird: you visit all three. Clarity arrives.
Work, travel, then decide. The pressure lifts.

events.title: Cracked screen
events.text: Your phone meets concrete. The spiderweb blooms.

effects.tpl: Ninety dollars later: flawless. A case is purchased immediately.
Three months of cracks. Character building, thumb-splintering.

events.title: Yearbook staff
events.text: Photo editor needed. You own a camera and opinions.

effects.tpl: Your spread wins the state award. History, documented.
Captions so good the principal quotes them.

events.title: Winter recital
events.text: Three minutes, one piano, two hundred eyes.

effects.tpl: Clean run, one shaky trill. Applause like rain.
Four hands, half the fear, double the fun.

events.title: Pizza oven nights
events.text: Friday pizza shifts: flour, fire, Friday chaos.

effects.tpl: Perfect leopard crusts. Tips pile up: 300 dollars.
Every porch found, every pizza hot. The town knows your car.

events.title: Pool pass summer
events.text: The public pool sells summer passes. The deep end waits.

effects.tpl: Butterfly is pain and glory. You medal in August.
Certified. Next summer pays.

events.title: The big ask
events.text: Prom looms. Someone worth asking keeps smiling at you.

then.tpl: Poster, petals, yes! The photos break the group chat.

else.tpl: A kind no. Your friends rally with ice cream.

effects.tpl: The crew table is the best table. Dance floor: conquered.

events.title: Lake weekend
events.text: Five friends, two tents, one borrowed minivan of snacks.

effects.tpl: Swims, stars, burnt hot dogs. The group chat gains lore.
Checklists save the trip twice. Leader status: you.

events.title: Robot season
events.text: Build season: six weeks, one robot, infinite pizza.

effects.tpl: You drive at regionals. The alliance wins silver.
Repairs in 90 seconds flat. The pit fears no breakdown.

events.title: Climbing gym
events.text: The climbing gym offers a teen team. The wall is 40 feet.

effects.tpl: Top-rope to lead in one season. The crux fears you.
Problems solved together. Falls laughed off.

events.title: Opinion column
events.text: The paper offers you 300 words monthly. The town reads it.

effects.tpl: Your lunch-menu investigation changes policy. Power of press.
The janitor's story moves the school. You find your beat.

events.title: Lead role shot
events.text: Auditions for the spring play. The lead has 200 lines.

then.tpl: The part is yours. Opening night: tears, applause, flowers.

else.tpl: Ensemble instead. You steal every scene you are in.

effects.tpl: Lighting design becomes your art. The show glows because of you.

events.title: Science olympiad
events.text: Build events, study events, one glorious contraption.

effects.tpl: Your balsa bridge holds 12 kilos. Medals: gold.
Every bone named. The test fears you.

else.tpl: Defeat. You wear a parka indoors out of spite.

effects.tpl: Quoted for years. Underclassmen memorize it.
The whole crew shares one line. Friendship, printed.
